name: proofwriter_depth_ood
design: train/val restricted to source_depth<=3; test = source_depth==5 only (depth generalization). test_id = depth<=3 held-out for the in-distribution contrast.
rationale: the full mixed-depth benchmark saturates (LM baselines .61-.65 strict, .94-.97 at slack 4), so it cannot separate methods; depth-5 generalization is the harder, discriminative setting.
